description: The SUPPRESS WHEN phrase of the ALTERNATE RECORD KEY clause (ISO 12.4.5.6.2) - alternate-key suppression: a record's alternate access path is withheld when the key value equals literal-1 (12.4.5.6.4 GR6), and the record is not considered to exist for READ/START. A COBOL-2023 addition; 0900 below 2023. Parses at all editions (superset), introduction-gated post-bind by VersionConformancePass.
display: the SUPPRESS WHEN phrase of the ALTERNATE RECORD KEY clause
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. ROWSUP.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT F ASSIGN TO "f.dat" ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED
               RECORD KEY IS R-KEY
               ALTERNATE RECORD KEY IS R-ALT SUPPRESS WHEN SPACES.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD F.
       01 R.
          05 R-KEY PIC X(4).
          05 R-ALT PIC X(4).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN. STOP RUN.
